shopQc.label: Shop's own quality check of returns
shopQc.help: On: staff check each returned piece at the shop (sellable or not). Only while the store uses the old ERP model; with the new model the owner checks every piece in the ERP and this never runs. Turned off at the switch-over.

restock.label: Send sellable returns back to ERP stock
restock.help: On: a piece the shop marked sellable goes back to the ERP as a return. Only on the old ERP model; turned off at the switch-over.

writeOff.label: Book unsellable returns as the shop's loss
writeOff.help: On: a piece the shop marked not sellable is booked as a return loss at its cost. Only on the old ERP model; with the new model a declined piece is the loss the ERP reports. Turned off at the switch-over.

creditDue.label: Note a credit when the exchange piece is cheaper
creditDue.help: On: when the new piece costs less, the difference is noted as due to the customer after the check. Only on the old ERP model: with the new model there are no refunds after delivery. Turned off at the switch-over.

days.label: Owner checks returns within (days)
days.help: How many days the owner has to check a returned piece in the ERP, counted from the courier's hand-back date: 7, 10 or 15. The ERP keeps this number; the shop shows the countdown with it.

runAt.label: Nightly compare with the ERP at
runAt.help: Every night at this time the Returns section is compared with the ERP's own counts for yesterday. A difference is fixed by pulling from the ERP again, never by editing a number.

months.label: Losses report covers (months)
months.help: How many months the losses report of the Returns section shows: 3, 6 or 12. It only changes what is shown; nothing is deleted.

keepForOrders.label: Pieces kept for regular orders
keepForOrders.help: Regular orders come first: an exchange waits when it would leave fewer than this many pieces of the new size free in the ERP. 1 means an exchange never takes the last piece.
